title: Preserve lint as an explicit quality gate after next lint removal
businessContext: Review a focused Next.js application change before it reaches production. The proposed file below contains the defect or unsupported assumption; external application services, where imported, are integration boundaries.
problemStatement: Review the proposed package.json change. Identify the incorrect framework assumption, propose a minimal corrected implementation, and provide evidence for the selected version scope and its 15/16 differences. Explain the interview variation after solving the base task. This is a framework code review: actual rendering, routing and cache behavior must be checked in a real Next.js build, not a browser function sandbox.
constraints: Preserve the stated user behavior and keep trust boundaries explicit.
Use the selected version’s documented API; do not suppress build/type failures to hide the defect.
Introduce a known lint violation and prove the check command fails.
Introduce a type error and prove the separate gate fails.
Restore both and run the production build.
candidateTasks: Add actionable line-level review comments explaining impact and correction.
Write the corrected file in the local IDE copy; split annotated companion files where instructed.
Record actual build/request/navigation evidence against the acceptance checks and compare version notes.
hints: A successful framework build is not evidence that a removed lint step still ran.
Introduce a known lint violation and prove the check command fails.
alternativeApproaches: Choose deliberate project scopes. Exclude candidate practice code from the app build, but retain a separate full tooling/test typecheck so reducing build scope does not silently abandon quality coverage.
commonMistakes: Verifying only next dev when the behavior depends on production rendering or bundling.
Treating a visible UI state, matcher or TypeScript type as a substitute for server-side validation and authorization.

verification: Introduce a known lint violation and prove the check command fails.
Introduce a type error and prove the separate gate fails.
Restore both and run the production build.
nextjsPractice.next15: An existing project may use next lint and version-specific build integration. Record the actual quality gates before migration.
nextjsPractice.next16: next lint is removed and next build does not run lint for you. Use an explicit ESLint CLI command and keep CI invoking it.
